mapper.select: WITH scoped_beds AS ( SELECT scope.bed_id FROM batch_bed_scope scope WHERE scope.batch_id = #{batchId} UNION SELECT bed.id FROM batch_room_scope scope JOIN bed ON bed.room_id = scope.room_id WHERE scope.batch_id = #{batchId} UNION SELECT bed.id FROM batch_building_scope scope JOIN dormitory_floor floor ON floor.building_id = scope.building_id JOIN room ON room.floor_id = floor.id JOIN bed ON bed.room_id = room.id WHERE scope.batch_id = #{batchId} ) SELECT bed.id, bed.bed_code, bed.bed_type, bed.position_index FROM scoped_beds scoped JOIN bed ON bed.id = scoped.bed_id AND bed.room_id = #{roomId} AND bed.operational_status = 'ENABLED' LEFT JOIN room_assignment occupied ON occupied.room_id = bed.room_id AND occupied.assignment_status = 'ACTIVE' AND occupied.bed_id = bed.id WHERE occupied.id IS NULL ORDER BY bed.position_index, bed.id
